scenarios.action: Measure bounded local resource sanity without inventing production guarantees.
scenarios.expectedResult: No catastrophic growth, unbounded list response, or timeout on ordinary supported datasets; the export cap refuses rather than truncates.
scenarios.privacyExpectation: Measurements use only fictional data.
scenarios.justifiedManualStep: Bounded local sanity pass recorded in the hardening report: confirm the 5,000-row export cap and pagination bounds are enforced by existing automated tests, then measure disposable-database row counts and a representative seed against the loopback database to confirm no catastrophic growth. This is not Phase 13 load testing and introduces no production guarantee.
